mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RULE_HIST ( RULEID , RULE_VERNO , RULE_NM , RULEALIAS_NM , RULE_DESC , RULERETURN_TYPE , RULESORT_CD , RULEUSAGE_CD , ALLRETURN_YN , USE_YN , ACTIVATE_YN , ACTIVATE_DATETIME , RULE_STATE , DEPLOY_DATETIME , DEPLOY_USERID , IFID , RULEVERSIONCHANGECODE , FIRSTREG_USERID , FIRSTREG_DATETIME , UPDATE_USERID , UPDATE_DATETIME ) SELECT RULEID , RULE_VERNO , RULE_NM , RULEALIAS_NM , RULE_DESC , RULERETURN_TYPE , RULESORT_CD , RULEUSAGE_CD , ALLRETURN_YN , USE_YN , ACTIVATE_YN , ACTIVATE_DATETIME , RULE_STATE , DEPLOY_DATETIME , DEPLOY_USERID , IFID , #{ruleversionchangecode} , FIRSTREG_USERID , FIRSTREG_DATETIME , UPDATE_USERID , UPDATE_DATETIME FROM RULE WHERE RULEID = #{ruleid}

INSERT INTO RULECONDITIONRETURNITEM_HIST ( RETURN_ITEMID , RULEID , RULECONDITIONNO , RULE_VERNO , RETURNITEM_EXPR_DESC , RETURNITEM_POSTFIX_DESC , FIRSTREG_USERID , FIRSTREG_DATETIME , UPDATE_USERID , UPDATE_DATETIME ) SELECT RETURN_ITEMID , RULEID , RULECONDITIONNO , #{ruleVerno} , RETURNITEM_EXPR_DESC , RETURNITEM_POSTFIX_DESC , FIRSTREG_USERID , FIRSTREG_DATETIME , UPDATE_USERID , UPDATE_DATETIME FROM RULECONDITIONRETURNITEM WHERE RULEID = #{ruleid}
mapper.select: SELECT RULEID , RULE_NM , RULEALIAS_NM , RULE_DESC , RULERETURN_TYPE , RULESORT_CD , RULEUSAGE_CD , ALLRETURN_YN , USE_YN , RULE_VERNO , ACTIVATE_YN , TO_CHAR(ACTIVATE_DATETIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ACTIVATE_DATETIME , ( SELECT CODE_NM FROM CLOVER_CODE WHERE CODE_TYPE = '604' AND CODE = SUBSTRING(RULE_STATE FROM 1 FOR 1) ) AS RULE_STATE , TO_CHAR(DEPLOY_DATETIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AS DEPLOY_DATETIME , ( SELECT USER_NM FROM CLOVER_USER WHERE USER_ID = DEPLOY_USERID ) AS DEPLOY_USERID , IFID , FIRSTREG_USERID , FIRSTREG_DATETIME , ( SELECT USER_NM FROM CLOVER_USER WHERE USER_ID = UPDATE_USERID ) AS UPDATE_USERID , ( SUBSTRING(UPDATE_DATETIME FROM 1 FOR 4) || '/' || SUBSTRING(UPDATE_DATETIME FROM 5 FOR 2) || '/' || SUBSTRING(UPDATE_DATETIME FROM 7 FOR 2) || ' ' || SUBSTRING(UPDATE_DATETIME FROM 9 FOR 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(UPDATE_DATETIME FROM 11 FOR 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(UPDATE_DATETIME FROM 13 FOR 2) ) AS UPDATE_DATETIME , RULEVERSIONCHANGECODE FROM RULE_HIST WHERE RULEID = #{ruleid} ORDER BY RULE_VERNO DESC

SELECT A.RULEID , A.RETURN_ITEMID , A.RULE_VERNO , A.RETURNITEM_NO , A.UPDATE_USERID , A.UPDATE_DATETIME , B.ITEM_NM , B.ITEMALIAS_NM , ( SELECT CODE_NM FROM CLOVER_CODE WHERE CODE_TYPE = '102' AND CODE = B.DATATYPE_CD ) AS DATATYPE_NM FROM RULERETURNITEM_HIST A , RULEITEM B WHERE A.RETURN_ITEMID = B.ITEMID AND RULEID = #{ruleid}

SELECT RULEID , RULECONDITIONNO , RULE_VERNO , CONDITION_INFIX_DESC , CONDITION_POSTFIX_DESC , CONDITION_DESC , FIRSTREG_USERID , FIRSTREG_DATETIME , UPDATE_USERID , UPDATE_DATETIME , ( SELECT STRING_AGG( RETURNITEM_EXPR_DESC, ':__:' ORDER BY RULECONDITIONNO ) FROM RULECONDITIONRETURNITEM_HIST WHERE RULEID = A.RULEID AND RULE_VERNO = A.RULE_VERNO AND RULECONDITIONNO = A.RULECONDITIONNO ) AS RESULT_VALUE FROM RULECONDITION_HIST A WHERE RULEID = #{ruleid}
